# UAM repository instructions

Read and follow `/AGENTS.md` before changing this repository. It is the shared human-and-agent working agreement.

Current delivery scope is G0 only. Use fictional data, preserve unrelated changes, keep raw evidence and secrets out of Git, and do not connect to live systems unless explicitly authorized.

For non-trivial work, use a task brief from `/docs/work/templates/`. Run `./scripts/validate-repository.sh` before handoff. Do not claim that research, an ADR, or an unrun test proves the implementation.
